utility.notes: Winters is a well-documented Yolo County city; PG&E delivers electricity, maintains lines, and provides billing, consistent with the established pattern for neighboring Davis and Woodland in this dataset.

value.name: Valley Clean Energy (VCE)
value.notes: Valley Clean Energy's own site confirms it is the official electricity provider for Woodland, Davis, Winters, and unincorporated Yolo County. VCE has served Woodland, Davis, and unincorporated Yolo County since June 2018, and welcomed the City of Winters in January 2021. PG&E continues to deliver the power, maintain lines, and handle billing and emergency services.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Winters/Yolo County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

required_documents.notes: The Building Division page describes general plan review and permitting responsibilities but does not itself detail solar-specific submittal requirements.

value: Contact the Building and Code Enforcement Division at 530-794-6708 to request an inspection
